rallyTimers.automaticCancelCondition: If no other alliance members join the rally before the timer expires, the rally march is automatically cancelled and stamina is refunded.

rallyTypes.name: Monster Rallies
rallyTypes.description: A minor coordinated rally used early on by new alliance members to defeat higher-tier common monsters without high losses.

rallyTypes.name: Elite Monster Rallies
rallyTypes.description: Standard high-value target runs targeting high stake region elite bosses to gather rare ores and equipment crests.

rallyTypes.name: World Boss Rallies
rallyTypes.description: Multi-player ultra raids against massive world bosses near the sovereign core throne. Massive rewards.

rallyTypes.name: Fortress Rallies
rallyTypes.description: Heavy siege style PvP / GvG campaign forces to storm, capture, or dismantle rival alliance territories.

tacticalAura.infantryLeaderBonus: If the initiator has Infantry specialized leadership, infantry defense is increased by 15% for all rally participants.
tacticalAura.cavalryLeaderBonus: If the initiator has Cavalry specialized leadership, cavalry travel speed is increased by 20% for all rally participants.
tacticalAura.marksmenLeaderBonus: If the initiator has Marksmen specialized leadership, marksmen armor penetration is increased by 10% for all rally participants.
